ImageInfoTest.pins: image metadata without loading the data: getImageSize, getImageSizeBatch, getImageDataType, getZarrInfo

batchSizesOfManyTiffs.pins: more than 100 files were read on background pool workers, which can't read tiff headers (thread-based workers run no mex files)

getZarrInfoOfMissingFileErrors.pins: get zarr info of missing file errors

queryingMetadataKeepsWarningState.pins: getImageSize and getZarrInfo used to turn off all warnings for the rest of the session

zarrFolderWithoutExtension.pins: zarr detection also works by the .zarray file

TiffIOTest.pins: readtiff/writetiff (Cpp-Tiff mex with libtiff/saveastiff fallbacks), readtiff_matlab, and interoperability with MATLAB's Tiff reader/writer

compressionOfWriteModes.pins: lzw stays the default; MATLAB's writer (libtiff mode, also the fallback) cannot write zstd and writes lzw instead

moreThan65535Pages.pins: regression test for the page number limit (d2a8d7d)

rangeReadOfImageJStack.pins: before Cpp-Tiff 1.6.1, range reads of single-IFD ImageJ stacks ignored the start of the range (slices 1-4 for [3, 6]), so cropping, MIPs and resampling with inputBbox got the wrong slices of large Fiji-saved stacks

readsImageJStack.pins: ImageJ/Fiji stacks are big-endian with contiguous pixel data and one IFD per slice; also a regression test for range reads of ImageJ files (f369d36)

readsSingleIfdImageJStack.pins: ImageJ saves stacks over 4 GB with only the first IFD; the number of slices is in the 'images=' description entry. The ARM macOS binaries read only the first slice before Cpp-Tiff 1.6.1.

readsTiffWrittenByMatlab.pins: multi-page stacks written by imwrite (libtiff), with and without compression

roundTripPreservesTypeAndValues.pins: round trip preserves type and values

unsupportedInputIsNotSilentlyDropped.pins: writetiff used to ignore the error code of its fallback writer (Cpp-Tiff rejects the data, saveastiff runs instead)

writeModesAreReadableByAllReaders.pins: write modes are readable by all readers

zstdIsReadByProcessingReaders.pins: the readers processing uses for tiff inputs: readtiff, image size and type, and regions of a blockedImage (MPageTiffAdapter). MATLAB's Tiff and imread cannot read zstd.

zstdRoundTrip.pins: opt-in zstd compression (Cpp-Tiff): same values and type, also for slice ranges

ZarrIOTest.pins: readzarr/writezarr/createzarr (Cpp-Zarr mex) round trips, partial reads and writes, compressors, chunk layouts, and .zarray metadata

blockSizeIsCappedAtImageSize.pins: block size is capped at image size

chunkOrderRoundTrip.pins: regression test for the C order chunk size issue (53c4e20)

image2dIsStoredWithSingletonZ.pins: image2d is stored with singleton z

partialWritesUpdateOnlyTheRegion.pins: also rewrites existing chunks, which takes a different code path (rename over an existing file) than the first write. On Windows, rewrites kept the old data before Cpp-Zarr 1.6.0.

readBoundingBoxPastTheEndErrors.pins: read bounding box past the end errors

roundTripPreservesTypeAndValues.pins: round trip preserves type and values

uuidFalseWritesChunksInPlace.pins: by default (and with uuid true) each chunk is written to a temporary file that replaces the chunk file; with uuid false the chunk file is written in place, so a hard link to it sees the new data
